questions.Description: Identify and analyze the given motherboard form factor.
Compare and tabulate the given motherboard form factors with respect to dimensions, power consumption and applications.
Disassemble the given motherboard, identify various components and reassemble it into working condition.
Identify the various expansion slots, memory slots, sockets, chipset etc. on a given motherboard.
Identify the various front panel and real panel connectors in an assembled PC. Also explain.

a) Expand the given RAM capacity of a PC using additional RAM slots.
b) Identify and connect a SATA and IDE Hard Disk Drive
c) Mount and connect an additional Hard Disk Drive and expand the storage capacity.

a) Install and configure a webcam and capture a photograph using it.
b) Install and configure a document Scanner and scan a physical document as image and
pdf using it.
c) Install and configure a biometric Scanner (fingerprint scanner) and perform
authentication using it.
Install and configure a laser printer and print a sample document on both sides of paper.
Install and configure a projector to a system with the help of VGA /HDMI cable and project the given media from a PC onto a screen.

a) Identify the cable colour codes and measure the output DC voltage from various
power cables of SMPS using multimeter.
b) Identify and connect the various output power cables of SMPS to appropriate
motherboard slots.

a) Identify the CMOS battery on a motherboard and measure the output voltage.
b) Connect two or more cells (battery) in series and parallel connection for required
voltage and current levels. Also measure the output using multimeter.
Troubleshoot the given faulty SMPS or UPS and identify the cause.

Enter the BIOS setup utility and demonstrate the following BIOS Setup and configurations:
A) System date and time, changing user passwords, change boot settings and priorities.
B) Factory Reset, Chipset configurations.
Install a windows OS in an assembled desktop PC.
Install any application software using windows command prompt (CMD).
